subject.title: fix(agents): repair orphaned tool_use pairs on compaction prune path

question: Should compaction adopt the existing prompt-send policy of dropping aborted assistant tool-call turns before summarization, instead of preserving them or synthesizing fake tool results?
rationale: The implementation is narrow, but the behavior trades recovery from invalid provider transcripts for losing partial aborted-turn context in summaries.

options.title: Accept drop policy
options.body: Merge this PR as the compaction counterpart to the existing prompt-send sanitizer behavior.

options.title: Require synthetic-result policy
options.body: Ask for a revised PR that preserves aborted turns by inserting explicit interrupted tool results instead of dropping them.

options.title: Pause for broader recovery design
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers want a unified product policy for aborted turns across replay, compaction, and durable repair first.

recommendation.title: Accept drop policy
recommendation.body: Merge this PR as the compaction counterpart to the existing prompt-send sanitizer behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest history-backed owner for the shared transcript repair helper and compaction paths that define this policy.
